newsitem.title: USA: SBC Communications inks local resale pact.
newsitem.headline: SBC Communications inks local resale pact.

text.p: Tie Communications Inc said Monday it signed a local interconnection resale agreement with Southwestern Bell Telephone Co covering five states.
Southwestern Bell, a unit of SBC Communications Inc, serves 14.2 million access lines in Kansas, Texas, Missouri, Oklahoma and Arkansas.

Tie Communications, a provider of business communications services, signed similar agreements with BellSouth Telecommunications to provide local services in the nine states where BellSouth provides local service.
